artifactType: bounded quantization-interval and rational-scale follow-up for v9 unresolved frames

candidateMethod.quantizationModel: For a normalized interval of physical length L, integer crop-edge floor/ceil can add a total of less than 2 pixels to s*L. Necessary scale range per axis is (max(0,(N-2)/L), N/L], where N is the stored native raster dimension. Intersect width and height ranges; empty intersections are retained as metadata/aspect incompatibility within this explicit model.
frameHypotheses: MediaBox-normalized top-left frame translated through CropBox into Page.rect coordinates only when MediaBox and Page.rect/CropBox differ
candidateMethod.commonTenthGrid: Scales k/10 from 0.5 to 4.0 are included only when inside the derived interval.
candidateMethod.positiveRequirement: Exact dimensions, exact complete RGB pixel bytes, and exact PNG SHA must all match. No resizing, padding, changed bounds, approximate RGB, or interval-only result counts as recovered.
candidateMethod.sourceIdentity: Canonical source PDF hashes and page counts were checked before rendering; catalog source identity, catalog hash, region id, image file hash and dimensions were also checked.

manualSourceImageReview.method: Viewed each of the six current target crops and each applicable canonical full page as a separate image result, never in a composite. Full-page canonical renders were generated directly from the SHA-pinned PDFs with PyMuPDF at 216 dpi. The PHB p.99 page was inspected once in Page.rect/CropBox frame and once in distinct MediaBox frame. Comparison was used only to locate physical regions and assess visible glyph boundaries; no semantic or completeness grade was made.

manualSourceImageReview.overallFinding: All six target images can be visually located on their canonical source pages in the expected physical areas. No included glyph is visibly clipped and no source-inherent glyph defect is established for these areas. Exact RGB/PNG replay remains absent for all six geometries across the finite, metadata-derived candidate scales. Result is renderer/frame-unestablished, not a confirmed declared-rectangle defect.
manualSourceImageReview.decision: No replacement crop proposed: this bounded geometry task establishes physical location but not intended semantic excerpt boundaries or historical rendering pipeline; replacing or widening crops would require a separate source-content/context review.
